sources.title: aitrainingdata (AI Training Data) · GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the AI Training Data repository! This project aims to be the largest public collection of AI training data, supporting a wide range of applications and research in artificial intelligence. By consolidating data into a single repository, we hope to make AI research and development more accessible and efficient.
